newsitem.title: USA: World Satellite Network CFO resigns.
newsitem.headline: World Satellite Network CFO resigns.

text.p: World Satellite Network Inc said Monday its chief financial officer, Richard Poston, would resign effective October 31 to re-enter the practice of public accounting.

Robert Ringstad, a certified public accountant with extensive financial and management experience, has been named vice president and chief financial officer, the satellite television programming distributor said.

Separately, president and chief executive officer Gary Hokkanen has resigned as a director of the company, though he will maintain his other duties, the company said. Hokkanen has been ill recently, Ringstad said. He did not elaborate.
The company said sales for fiscal year 1996, ended August 31, were just over $26 million compared with $23.54 million for fiscal year 1995.
